name: showboard
description: Claude answers questions about your spreadsheets or database with charts, tables and notes, in a pane beside the chat and on a board page in your browser. Read-only, and it runs on your computer.

data.title: Data
data.description: The full path of a folder of spreadsheets (.xlsx, .csv), one spreadsheet, or a SQLite file. Only read, never changed. Empty: Showboard waits until you set it.

database_url.title: Database URL
database_url.description: A Postgres URL, such as postgres://reader:secret@localhost:5432/shop, used instead of Data. Give it a user that can only read.

url.title: Showboard URL
url.description: Where the pane looks for Showboard, such as an app's http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/showboard. Empty: this folder's .mcp.json, else the plugin's own Showboard.
